# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read `BUILD-RULES.md` and the relevant product/design/technical document before implementing. This project is a lead-generation showcase of five fictional Karachi food-sector page concepts, not a directory, ordering service, CMS, or marketplace. Preserve the approved scope, avoid fabricated business claims or contact details, use the shared typed demo data, and keep the central showcase accessible on touch, keyboard, and reduced-motion settings. Run and report relevant checks; do not claim checks passed unless they ran.

When a task matches a focused procedure, read the corresponding file before editing: `.agents/skills/food-showcase-scope/SKILL.md` for scope or feature decisions; `.agents/skills/karachi-food-demo-pages/SKILL.md` for sector content; `.agents/skills/accessible-food-carousel/SKILL.md` for the home gallery; `.agents/skills/food-mvp-release-gate/SKILL.md` for verification or release.
